stories.title: Everest South Col Expedition 2023
stories.participants: Sarah Collins, Tenzin Sherpa, Mark Bennett
stories.achievement: Team-summit Everest via the South Col route, raising funds for mountain schools.
stories.details: The team spent seven weeks at base camp and higher camps, acclimatizing carefully through the Khumbu Icefall. After a difficult push through the South Col, all three members stood on the summit on a clear, windless morning. The expedition combined climbing with a fundraising effort that built two schools in the Khumbu Valley.

stories.title: K2 Base Camp Trek
stories.achievement: Completed the arduous trek to K2 Base Camp via Concordia along the Baltoro Glacier.
stories.alt: Trekking on the Baltoro Glacier toward K2
stories.details: A 21-day trek through some of the world's most dramatic mountain scenery, crossing the Baltoro Glacier to reach Concordia and finally K2 Base Camp. The pair documented life in the high mountain villages and the work of local porters who make these expeditions possible.

stories.title: First Winter Ascent of Diran Peak
stories.participants: Lukas Steiner, Amin Karim, Elena Petrova
stories.achievement: Achieved a new winter route up the 7,266m Diran Peak in alpine style.
stories.alt: Snow-covered Diran Peak rising above the Rakaposhi valley
stories.details: In brutal winter conditions the three climbers established a new line on Diran's north face, climbing entirely without fixed ropes or supplemental oxygen. The ascent marked the first winter summit of Diran and won international recognition for its bold alpine style.

stories.title: Alpine Skills Youth Camp
stories.achievement: Introduced mountaineering skills to 24 young climbers through a structured training camp.
stories.alt: Mountain camp in the Chamonix valley
stories.details: A hands-on course teaching crevasse rescue, glacier travel, navigation and camping to the next generation of climbers. The camp culminated in a guided ascent of Mont Blanc du Tacul, giving each student a genuine high-alpine summit experience.

stories.title: Matterhorn Classic Hornli Ridge
stories.achievement: A clean, successful ascent of the Matterhorn's iconic Hornli Ridge.
stories.alt: The striking silhouette of the Matterhorn
stories.details: Climbing the legendary Hornli Ridge in near-perfect conditions, the pair moved efficiently through the mixed rock terrain. Their preparation and route-reading paid off in a textbook ascent of one of the Alps' most iconic summits.

stories.title: Broad Peak Base Camp Expedition
stories.achievement: Supported a summit team and documented life at 4,900m at Broad Peak Base Camp.
stories.alt: Broad Peak towering above base camp
stories.details: Working as part of a larger expedition, the team managed logistics, weather monitoring and communications at base camp while supporting the climbing team's push. Their behind-the-scenes work proved vital to the expedition's safety and success.
